description: This 100 sq yd plot sits inside Bhomsingh Enclave in Bhondsi, near the Sohna toll. It measures 50 ft by 18 ft, opens onto a 20 ft wide colony lane and has boundary walls on its sides. The lane already has built homes around it. Registry is available. Message Right Property Club on WhatsApp for the price, documents and a site visit.
